summary: Reproduced and diagnosed deployment port mismatch defect on Railway where startup commands hardcoded port 8000 instead of dynamically evaluating ${PORT}.
evidence: Observed deployment verification failure: AssertionError: DEPLOYMENT CONFIG DEFECT: Railway startCommand hardcodes a static port instead of using ${PORT} in apps/api/railway.json and apps/api/Dockerfile.
Formed accurate diagnostic hypothesis: Railway dynamically assigns an ephemeral container port via $PORT, while Uvicorn was configured to bind statically to 8000, causing edge proxy routing timeouts.
Identified the resolution: update startup commands across railway.json and Dockerfile to dynamically bind to '0.0.0.0' and '${PORT:-8000}' while preserving pre-flight Alembic migrations.
